picked.description: Details whether a goods out note has been printed.

priority.description: The priority of the goods out note.

releaseDate.description: The date the goods out note is to be released.

shipped.description: Details whether a goods out note has been shipped.

shippedOn.description: The date the goods out note was shipped on.

transfer.description: Details whether a goods out note is a transfer.

contactId.description: The ID of the Contact. Can be used to recover all information about a contact by issuing a Contact GET.

createdById.description: The ID of the Staff member who created this order.

createdOn.description: The date the Order was created.

customerRef.description: The customer reference for the order.

deliveryDate.description: The date the delivery is set for.

departmentId.description: The ID of the department the Order is associated with.

externalRef.description: The external reference for the order

installedIntegrationInstanceId.description: The integration instance this order is associated with

orderId.description: The ID of the Order. Can be used to retrieve all order information using Order Get.

orderPaymentStatusId.description: The payment status ID of the order

orderShippingStatusId.description: The shipping status ID of the order

orderStatusId.description: The ID of the Order status. Description can be found in the report reference data.

orderStockStatusId.description: The ID of the Order stock status. Description can be found in the report reference data.

orderTypeId.description: The ID of the Order Type. See report reference data for description.

parentOrderId.description: The ID of the order's parent. Orders have a parent when they are linked to another order, for example a sales credit linked to a sales order.

staffOwnerContactId.description: The ID of the staff member who is assigned to the order.

taxDate.description: The tax date of the order.

updatedOn.description: The date the Order was updated.

warehouseId.description: The ID of the warehouse. Can be used to retrieve all orders for a given warehouse ID.
